'''Chapter 342''' is called "The Messengers of Darkness".

==Cover Page==
[[Gedatsu's Accidental Blue-Sea Life]], Vol. 26: "Grand Opening: The [[Hasami]] Undersea Bus".

To ferry patrons through the tunnel between [[Arabasta Kingdom]] and [[Ukkari Hot-Spring Island|Ukkari Island]], yet another giant animal is employed: [[Hasami]] the moving crab.

==Short Summary==
The [[Franky Family]] think of a way to lure out the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] while the [[CP9]] and [[Nico Robin]] begin an attack on the [[Galley-La Headquarters]].

==Long Summary==
With [[Mozu and Kiwi]] struggling to keep up with the wind, [[Franky]] roams [[Water 7]] in search for [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]. The other members catch up with them and inform them that they saw [[Usopp]], who they still believe to be a member of the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]], alone on the [[Going Merry]]. In an attempt to lure out Luffy, Franky decides to kidnap Usopp as bait.

At the [[Galley-La Headquarters]], the four remaining Straw Hats continue to keep watch. Inside, [[Iceburg]] requests [[Kalifa]] to leave and to send in [[Paulie]]. Complying with his wishes, she leaves the area after sending in Paulie while the other four leave their seats as not to overhear. Iceburg is seen giving details of a task which Paulie accepts without question. As he leaves the room, he gives his excuses and leaves the remaining four to keep watch. He is next seen in the President's Room finding a safe and entering a combination which Iceburg gave him.

[[Nico Robin]] along with the [[Blueno|bear-masked man]] are seen standing on a rooftop answering a [[Den Den Mushi]] saying they are both ready. An explosion suddenly goes off at the Galley-La Headquarters alerting everyone around the area and starting a panic causing [[Tilestone]] and [[Peepley Lulu]] to leave their post. A musketeer-styled assailant is seen being chased around using a spiked whip to escape to a higher floor where they are confronted by more [[Galley-La Company|Galley-La workers]]. Robin and the bear-masked man are also being chased around the area.

The Straw Hats, who were busy observing the chaos, realize that Luffy has disappeared.

Back in the President's Room, Paulie has found a pile of papers in the safe just as two other masked men appear.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Franky]] plans to use [[Usopp]] as bait to lure out the [[Straw Hat Pirates]].
*[[Paulie]] finds documents in a safe which [[CP9]] seem to be after.
*It is revealed that there are four [[CP9]] members working with [[Nico Robin|Robin]] as she and her unknown masked partner prepare to assault the mansion.
*During the commotion, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] disappears.
